item.description: The Labour Market Regulatory Authority (LMRA) announced the implementation of 1,171 inspection campaigns and visits during the period of January 18-24, which resulted in the detention of 14 violating and irregular workers, while 88 violators were deported. item.title: Emirates And Air Peace Activate Interline Agreement
item.description: Emirates, the world’s largest international airline, and Air Peace, West Africa’s largest carrier, have activated a bilateral interline agreement, strengthening air connectivity between Africa, the United Arab Emirates and the United Kingdom. item.title: Meta To Test Premium Subscriptions On Instagram, Facebook And Whatsapp
item.description: Meta is preparing to test premium subscription tiers across its three most widely used apps — Instagram, Facebook and WhatsApp — in what could be a significant shift in how the company monetises its social platforms beyond advertising. item.title: Porsche Middle East And Africa Sales Accelerate 55 Per Cent Since 2020 As Deliveries Hit 9,628, Led By The 911
item.description: Porsche Middle East and Africa has achieved its best annual sales performance in 12 years, recording 55 per cent growth in regional sales since 2020. A total of 9,628 new vehicles were delivered during the 2025 calendar year across the Middle East, Africa, Levant and India region, representing one per cent growth compared to the previous year. item.title: Commerce Ministry Carries Out 17,500 Inspection Tours In Makkah And Madinah Ahead Of Ramadan
item.description: The Ministry of Commerce announced that its inspection teams conducted a total of 17,500 visits in the Makkah and Madinah regions between Rajab 1 and Shaaban 5, 1447 AH. These inspections covered central markets, hypermarkets, and retail outlets in the central Haram area, as well as gold and jewellery shops, gas stations on the roads leading to Makkah and Madinah, and designated locations for pilgrims entering the state of Ihram. item.title: Saudi, Omani Naval Forces Take Part As “Winds of Peace 2026” Exercise Kicks Off in Oman
item.description: The Royal Saudi Naval Forces and the Royal Navy of Oman are taking part in the joint naval exercise titled “Winds of Peace 2026,” which kicked off in the Sultanate of Oman on Monday. This is part of the efforts to strengthen military cooperation between the two friendly neighboring countries.
